learning_outcomes.text: Apply Circular 230 practice rules, duties and sanctions for practice before the IRS
Represent taxpayers in examinations, appeals, collection and penalty matters
Handle specific representation situations including powers of attorney and third-party authorizations
Complete the filing process with required e-file, recordkeeping and preparer obligations
